They follow the Cup roster, not the results. The primary comparisons are shown both ways: with the additions (the primary result, §10.14(b)) and with the original members only (22 setups, §10.14(d)).
cost_note: Recorded cost (the field billed_usd_per_1000) is the cost stored with each answer: the provider's reported cost per response where the route reports one, otherwise the runner's list-price computation (Mercury Decide: list price; its provider-billed amount was not retained and is unknown). No invoice was checked. API-equivalent is a subscription setup priced at list price, not money paid. Setups on our GPUs have no list price.

groups_rule: Groups by original league (Method §10.14, amendment of 2026-10-27). Method §10 and its notes were committed before any model call, and the per-setup first looks were computed under the frozen extension rule. Separately, before the amendment, six full-report calls were issued on partial data under the earlier group definitions; that all six completed successfully has not been independently established. One returned numeric old-group primary results into the site agent's context before the amendment. Whether a person saw them, and any causation, is not established. Nothing was published before the amendment; the aggregate report and data were pushed to the public repository in commit 3e4f413 on 2026-10-28 (01:03 UTC), before release approval. See §10.14(e) and its dated correction (f) of 2026-10-28.
limit_note: Output limit (§10.14(h)): an answer cut off at 32,768 output tokens counts as invalid, with its own sensitivity check (cut-off pairs left out). No recorded answer was cut off at the limit. Past 32,768 output tokens from a run that sent no limit (flagged; the answers keep their scores): Grok 4.7 (high), 17 of its recorded positions (7 standard / 10 Nackgammon), 7 in the main 200 pairs.
missing_note: LFM2.5-24B-A2B (on): 107 positions recorded without a valid choice (timeouts or missing choices), 38 in the main 200 pairs and 69 in the reserve; on its final 500 pairs 55 standard / 52 Nackgammon; Grok 4.7 (high): 34 positions recorded without a valid choice (timeouts or missing choices), 15 in the main 200 pairs and 19 in the reserve; on its final 500 pairs 16 standard / 18 Nackgammon. They are not answers: each is scored by the primary rule (the position's Random error), with both sensitivity checks below. Every other asked setup gave a valid choice on every recorded position.
